info.name: Furret's World
info.description:
On most websites, a horde of Furret will walk across your screen.
Cons: It might be a little harder to focus on the content.
Pros: But hey, you've got Furret strolling around—what's not to love?
info.additionalInfo:
Furrets will continuously move from right to left. However, they won't randomly pop up; they'll just loop around the same Y-position. Their position is absolute; they won't move with screen scrolling, like a Sticker on your screen. Furret won’t interfere with your ability to interact with the website. You can still click, scroll, and navigate normally.

Some websites may experience a slight scroll offset.
